name: Resistance Band Romanian Deadlift
description: A band hip hinge: standing on the band, hinge down and take the ends short so the band is taut, then squeeze your glutes to stand. Each rep, push your hips back until your torso is nearly level, then stand again against the band.

source.title: Band-Resisted Romanian Deadlift (Girls Gone Strong)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on the middle of the band, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and take the ends short, just below your knees, so the band is taut, then stand up.
cues: Flat back, soft knees, chest open.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Take the band
keyframes.cue: Hinge down and take the ends short, just below your knees, so the band is taut.

keyframes.name: Stand
keyframes.cue: Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.

keyframes.name: Hinge
keyframes.cue: Push your hips back until your torso is nearly level.

keyframes.name: Stand tall
keyframes.cue: Stand up and step off the band.
